prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Reference 1 is the exact OFFICIAL COSTUME AND COLOUR authority. Reference 2 supplies the game's character identity, slender proportions and polished 2D drawing style ONLY, not its old clothing. Adapt the official costume to the game character; do not reproduce the short plush/vinyl proportions or the photographed background.

RIBBIT in the official NOIR merchandise costume. One slim anthropomorphic frog: one grey frog head with two large raised oval eyes, black pupils with white highlights, very dark violet half-lids, a light-grey muzzle and small weary downturned mouth. Grey skin, no green and no pink cheeks. Grey trench coat with lapels, overlapping front, waist belt and square buckle, white shirt collar, small black neck bow. Two grey frog hands at the ends of the coat sleeves; two long slim legs ending in black rounded frog feet. Keep the established game's slender Ribbit proportions and bold clean cel shading. Preserve this complete grey outfit and subdued expression. No hat, cigarette, weapon, keyring, tag, strap or lettering.

Selection portrait: full-body standing character, relaxed and clearly readable, body in three-quarter view oriented toward SCREEN-RIGHT. Both feet separated, arms relaxed with one small expressive gesture. Every part of the character and costume fully visible.

Render ONE complete polished hand-drawn 2D cel-shaded fighting-game sprite with clean dark outlines and clear flat colour regions. Entire figure including every eye, hat tip, feather tip, finger and both feet is fully inside generous transparent safety margins. True transparent RGBA background. No floor, cast shadow, glow, background, frame, text, watermark, duplicate body, speed lines or motion blur. Anatomical consistency is mandatory: one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Native facing must be SCREEN-RIGHT; do not mirror anatomical costume details.

observations: Ribbit gris, grands yeux à paupières violet sombre, museau clair et bouche maussade conformes à la référence de marchandise.
Trench gris ceinturé à boucle carrée, col blanc, nœud noir, deux mains grises et deux pieds noirs entièrement visibles ; proportions élancées du jeu et orientation droite.
Sélection approuvée comme verrou visuel des dix actions ; anneau et sangle exclus.
visualReview.scope: Official merchandise costume and game presentation; pose adaptation, no canonical episode certification.
